classes.desc: GROUP BY lists, kept on one line
HAVING conditions, AND / OR on new lines like WHERE
ORDER BY with ASC / DESC, LIMIT and OFFSET

cases.name: single column
cases.sql: select country, count(*) from users group by country

cases.name: multiple columns with where
cases.sql: select country, city, count(*) as n from users where active = 1 group by country, city

cases.name: positional columns
cases.sql: select country, count(*) from users group   by 1

cases.name: single condition
cases.sql: select country, count(*) as n from users group by country having count(*) > 10

cases.name: HAVING with AND
cases.sql: select user_id, sum(amount) from orders group by user_id having count(*) > 10 and sum(amount) < 1000

cases.name: order by desc
cases.sql: select * from orders order by created_at desc

cases.name: order by several columns with limit and offset
cases.sql: select id, amount from orders order by amount desc, id asc limit 10 offset 20
format_want: ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC

cases.name: all clauses
cases.sql: select country, count(*) as n from users where active = 1 and age >= 18 group by country having count(*) > 5 order by n desc limit 3
